title: Anthropic (LLM)
description: Anthropic's Claude models as an LLM tier, through gohort's Anthropic client, with the key kept in a credential rather than in the LLM settings.
setup_notes: Create a key at console.anthropic.com (API keys). The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which makes one short real chat. Then pick it under Admin > LLMs > Worker LLM (or Lead LLM) as Service: <name>: the tier's turns run on it through gohort's own Anthropic client, streaming and tool calls as usual, and the key stays in the credential. Its calls and their cost show on the connector's row; add per_million_input and per_million_output to its spec's cost to price its tokens, which then replace the tier's rates under Costs.

questions.name: api_key
questions.label: API key
questions.help: Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector or the LLM settings.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the LLM settings list it by this name.

questions.name: model
questions.label: Model
questions.help: The model a tier on it runs unless the tier names another.
